input: Draft a short bio for my conference speaker profile

gold.taskDescription: Write a short professional biography to be used on a conference speaker profile page.

questions.title: What is your current job title and employer?
questions.description: Understand the user's professional role and organization to anchor the bio.

questions.title: What is the conference topic or industry focus?
questions.description: Know the conference theme so the bio can be tailored to the right audience.

questions.title: What is the word or character limit for the bio?
questions.description: Determine the required length to match the conference profile format.

questions.title: What are your top two or three career achievements to highlight?
questions.description: Identify the most impressive accomplishments to feature prominently.

questions.title: What is the topic of your conference talk?
questions.description: Connect the bio to the specific subject the user will be speaking about.

questions.title: Should the tone be formal, conversational, or something else?
questions.description: Capture the user's preferred voice and style for the written bio.

questions.title: Should the bio be written in first or third person?
questions.description: Confirm the grammatical perspective the conference requires or the user prefers.
